entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A desert-born Samite healer, core Weatherlight crew member, healer, quartermaster, tailor and interpreter.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Hanna of Tolaria, Orim's friend from the Argivian University who joined the Weatherlight with her.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Mercadian leader Orim loved and returned to.

entities.name: Oriss
entities.description: Orim's daughter, a Samite who followed her tradition.

entities.name: Argivian University
entities.description: University where Orim studied Samite arts.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where Orim helped the crew and the Revolution.

entities.name: Revolution on Mercadia
entities.description: Revolution roused by Orim and Cho-Manno.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: War during which Orim found a cure for the plague.

entities.name: Samite
entities.description: Healing tradition Orim studied and later founded in Mercadia.

events.summary: Orim studies the Samite arts at the Argivian University in New Argive, where she meets Hanna.
events.quote: This is where she first met Hanna of Tolaria

events.summary: Orim and Hanna join the Weatherlight crew; Orim becomes chief healer, quartermaster, tailor and interpreter.
events.quote: They joined the Weatherlight Crew at the same time

events.summary: Orim helps save the crew in Mercadia and with Cho-Manno rouses the people to revolution.
Orim finds a cure for the Phyrexian plague during the Invasion.
events.quote: she found a cure for the Phyrexian plague

events.summary: Orim returns to Mercadia to be with Cho-Manno.
events.quote: ultimately returned to Mercadia to be with her love
